title: News live: Alan Kohler announces retirement from ABC after 31 years; six Australian universities in top 100 global rankings
text: 20.18 EDT Alan Kohler to retire from the ABC after 31 years Alan Kohler will retire from the ABC at the end of this year, capping a three decade-tenure at the national broadcaster. Kohler joined the ABC in 1995 as a business correspondent and has been the lead finance presenter for the 7pm news since 2002. His trademark signoff – “And that’s finance” – has greeted viewers for years. He said in a statement: I love the ABC, always have, even more so after I joined it. I find it very hard to imagine this wonderful place not being part of my life, but I’m 74 and it’s time to spend more time with my family, including the six grandchildren. His last report will be 16 December.
author: Nick Visser

title: Supreme court allows Trump to temporarily resume deporting people to third countries – live
text: 15.27 EDT Supreme court allows Trump to resume deporting people to third countries for now while justices weigh policy The supreme court has allowed the Trump administration to resume deporting people to countries other than their own without offering them the chance to show the harms they may face, bolstering a tool Donald Trump has used for rapid expulsions as part of ⁠his immigration crackdown. The justices granted the DOJ’s request to halt ​Boston-based US district judge Brian Murphy’s ruling that the Department of Homeland Security’s policy to remove migrants to so-called third countries is unlawful , while the administration appeals the matter to the supreme court. They also agreed to hear arguments in the dispute in December, with a ⁠formal ruling on policy to follow. Its three liberal justices dissented from the decision. Federal attorneys said the lower-court decision forced the cancellation of a deportation flight carrying about 70 people bound for three countries. The justices previously allowed the deportation flights, a core Trump administration policy, to temporarily continue when the case came before them last year. Как студент-заочник, он получил возможность заключить спецконтракт. Опыт предыдущей работы помог определить специализацию. Условиями «Полюс» доволен: бойцам выдали положенное довольствие, кормят прилично, работа важная для страны.
